summary: First comprehensive test run of Max Power Bussines (POS + Dashboard + Caja + RBAC). Ran 41 pytest backend tests (100% pass) and executed Playwright flows against the public URL for login, dashboard, nav visibility by role, POS checkout (cash + card), cart +/- qty, ventas (admin anular + cajero no-void), inventario CRUD, alertas panels and usuarios page (incl. permission matrix, own-role disabled). All critical flows work.

issues: Container element has data-testid='pos-product-grid' which overlaps the data-testid prefix 'pos-product-' used for product cards. Query 'data-testid^="pos-product-"' returns the grid too. Not blocking (product testids are pos-product-<product_id>), but using a different grid testid such as 'pos-grid' would avoid future selector collisions.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_user guard: expression (changes.get('role','admin') != 'admin' or changes.get('active',True) is False) raises 400 for any PUT on an admin self/owner even when only name is updated (role missing defaults to 'admin' so first clause false; active missing defaults True so False — ok). Logic is correct but subtle; consider rewriting as: if (new_role and new_role != 'admin') or (new_active is False): raise.
server.py seed_database runs on every FastAPI startup — ensure it is idempotent to avoid data drift between restarts.
Frontend POS uses hard-coded TAX=0.16 and server uses TAX_RATE env; if TAX_RATE changes the frontend preview will drift from backend-computed total. Consider exposing TAX_RATE via /api/config.
Dashboard endpoint builds 'daily' dict using date keys — safe but 'since' uses days+1 which fetches an extra day; harmless.

/api/sales create_sale decrements stock via conditional update and rolls back on failure — good pattern; however folio counter is incremented AFTER stock changes, so a crash between the two leaves orphan stock decrement without sale. Low risk, acceptable for MVP.
Layout.jsx NavItems reads 'can' from useAuth each render — fine; data-testids present on all interactive elements. Good test coverage ready.
test_credentials: Bearer sessions already seeded: test_session_admin (admin), test_session_cajero (cajero, open caja). Gerente/pendiente test users were created via mongosh and DELETED after testing per request.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test-gerente-1/test-pendiente-1 users + their sessions. Created and deleted TEST_UI product and TEST_* products via tests. test.user.admin and test.user.cajero preserved. No seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and RBAC verified via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (41 tests). To re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. For gerente/pendiente coverage recreate sessions per /app/auth_testing.md. Note: button[data-testid^='pos-product-prd'] is the reliable selector for POS product cards; the generic prefix 'pos-product-' also matches the grid container. Cajero session has an open caja (caja_f84c120bce) and sales history — do not close it unless re-testing caja close/alert flow.
